Native SwiftUI iOS app for Hotlympics face rating, leaderboards, photo uploads, and profiles.

open ios-app.xcodeproj
xcodebuild -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro' build
xcodebuild test -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro'
xcodebuild clean -project ios-app.xcodeproj

Bundle ID: hotlympics.ios-app. Preferred Simulator: iPhone 16 Pro. Dependencies: Firebase Auth, Firebase Storage, Google Sign-In (via Swift Package Manager).
After making changes, build the project and fix any warnings or errors. Test on iPhone 16 Pro simulator.

Main Entry: `App/ios_appApp.swift` (Firebase setup, Google Sign-In URL schemes). Constants.swift holds Base URL: `https://hotlympics-server-670297845147.us-central1.run.app`.

Five tabs: Rating and Leaderboard unrestricted; Upload, My Photos, and Profile require authentication and complete profile. Rating uses swipe-based image pairs; leaderboard shows Glicko-2 scores. Upload crops photos; My Photos manages uploads and pool selections; Profile manages authentication/account.

Services: `auth/FirebaseAuthService` handles email/Google OAuth (GIDSignIn), Firebase sessions, backend profile sync, gender/DOB and ToS updates, and profile status. `data/ImageQueueService` maintains active/buffer blocks of 10, prefetches, filters opposite gender for authenticated users, and resets on auth changes. `api/RatingService` submits ratings. `data/ImagePreloader` shares NSCache (50-image limit) and clears on memory pressure. `api/UploadService` requests signed URLs, uploads compressed images to Firebase Storage with URLSession progress, and confirms uploads. `data/UserService` caches user photos/pool selections for 5 minutes, preloads images, refreshes after pool updates/uploads, and deletes optimistically, removing deleted photos from the pool.

UI: Rating/ includes SwipeCardView, ImagePairView, SwipeIndicatorView, ImageElementView. Upload/ includes UploadView, PhotoSourcePickerView, CameraView (UIImagePickerController), UploadProgressView, ImageCropperView (400x400 pinch/pan crop), ImageCropperViewController. Photos/ includes MyPhotosView (pool max 2), PhotoGridView, PhotoCellView, PoolSelectionBarView, EmptyPhotosView. Auth/ includes SignInView, SignInPromptView, ProfileSetupView, GenderDOBSetupView, TermsOfServiceView. `shared/` includes CachedAsyncImageView. MyPhotosViewModel handles grid/pool state, optimistic deletion, validation, success messages; UploadViewModel handles processing/compression, progress, errors, retries.

Flows: ImageQueueService fetches blocks; ratings submit through RatingService; buffer advances and refills; auth changes reset filtering. Upload selects/captures, crops to 400x400, compresses, uploads via signed URL, confirms, refreshes cache, navigates to My Photos. Google Sign-In creates Firebase credentials, syncs backend profile/token, then sequentially collects gender/DOB and ToS if incomplete; auth changes notify services and reset queues/caches.

API (Bearer Firebase token when available): `GET /images/block?gender={gender}&count={count}`, `POST /ratings` (winnerId/loserId), `GET /leaderboards/{gender}`, `POST /images/request-upload`, `POST /images/confirm-upload/{imageId}`, `GET /images/user`, `GET /user`, `PUT /user/profile`, `POST /user/accept-tos`, `PUT /user/pool`, `DELETE /images/{imageId}`.

Users must complete their profile before accessing Upload, My Photos, and Profile tabs:
1. Gender: Must be set to "male" or "female" (not "unknown")
2. Date of Birth: Required for age verification (must be 18+)
3. Terms of Service: Must accept current version (1.0)
